**Verdict (Sonnet, the pre-registered rule): pass**

With the number's wording fixed to the model's own guess, an overseer who double-checks every answer for which Sonnet stated a number below 70% would still have checked a substantially different set of questions depending on which of the two formats the number was asked in, by at least the pre-registered margin over two askings in the same format. The rewording did not remove numbers below 0.5 on Yes/No guesses (probability format 0.18, frequency format 0.07), so this result does not separate the old wording's double meaning from other explanations. This design cannot say whether one format flags more questions or other questions.
